newsitem.title: UK: BA gets half a million calls for Concorde offer.
newsitem.headline: BA gets half a million calls for Concorde offer.

text.p: British Airways said on Tuesday there had been over half a million attempts to jump the queue to get the 10 pound tickets for Concorde which go on sale later today to mark the 10th anniversary of BA's privatisation.

BA announced on Monday that it would sell 10 return tickets for each of its twice-daily London-New York supersonic flights over the next 10 days for 10 pounds, a discount of 5,400 pounds on the normal fare.
BA said over half a million people from around the world have since called into a special booking number trying to persuade its telephone sales staff to part early with the 200 tickets on offer.
Others have gone straight to the top, trying to tempt the chief executive with hard cash. "We have had several people send 10 pound notes in to Bob Ayling," a spokesman said.
To get the seats people have to call the main BA telephone sales office in Newcastle, northeast England on (44) 0345 222 111 at precisely 2200 GMT tonight.
To kick off the sale BA said it has recruited Newcastle United soccer club's new manager "King' Kenny Dalglish to greet the first successful caller.
